mapper.select: SELECT id, subbarcode, contracts_no AS studyNo, order_code AS projectNo, pcode AS participantNo, testing_institution AS center, collect_date AS receiveDate, sample_type AS sampleType, specimen_num AS sampleCount, erp_test_name AS product, customer_name AS customerName FROM sample_file WHERE subbarcode = #{subbarcode} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tenant_id FROM sample_file WHERE subbarcode = #{subbarcode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT n.id AS lastNotifyId, n.subbarcode AS subbarcode, n.sample_file_id AS sampleFileId, n.qc_category AS qcCategory, n.wet_lab_qc_id AS wetLabQcId, n.bioinfo_qc_id AS bioinfoQcId, n.notify_no AS notifyNo, n.notify_status AS notifyStatus, n.analysis_time AS analysisTime, n.product AS product, n.customer_name AS customerName, n.sample_type AS sampleType, n.qc_stage AS qcStage, n.terminate_measure AS terminateMeasure, n.remedy AS remedy, n.reason AS reason, n.remedy_other AS remedyOtherText, n.reporter AS reporter, n.report_time AS reportTime, n.reviewer AS reviewer, n.review_time AS reviewTime, n.raw_docx_path AS lastDocxName, n.pdf_path AS lastPdfName, DATE_FORMAT(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastGeneratedAt, TRUE AS `generated` -- generated 是 MySQL 保留字，别名必须反引号 FROM qc_failed_notify n WHERE n.subbarcode = #{subbarcode} AND n.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 1
